rows.text: The official version of "Simulated Universe"! Forget about the previous beta version. There are lots of changes. Do you want me to give you the patch notes?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Just say them out loud to me.
I'll figure it out myself.
Nah, I'm not interested.
You have zero manners...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Firstly, Stephen has made significant adjustments to the gameplay loop. According to him, "The challenge goal of each phase is even clearer" — I don't really get it. Just because I'm a genius doesn't mean I understand gaming — so whatever he says goes.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: This version offers a higher degree of freedom. You can mix and match your team, choose from a variety of Blessings, and there are even random events to guarantee you a unique experience every time.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Finally, there's a new mechanic that helps you to better pretend to be Akivili.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Alright, stay curious.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Alright. You'll find out soon enough.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You suddenly lose control of your limbs. Herta — the Simulated Universe's most powerful being — has revoked your permissions again, and the puppet's angry voice sounds in your ear: "Why didn't you hit that thing?"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: What?
"That thing," Herta says impatiently, "that's what you usually smash with a bat when you walk past it on the road. Why didn't you go and hit it? Can't you see it?"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Sorry, I didn't see it.
I'm psychologically well and don't need to hit anything.
"You didn't see it..." You can hear Herta muttering angrily with gritted teeth. "You are so young, yet you have no idea how to be observant..."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "What a snob..." You can hear Herta muttering angrily with gritted teeth. "Isn't playing games all about smashing up everything you can see...?"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "The Simulated Universe is different from the real world. Destructible objects will drop useful Cosmic Fragments. Now, go back and hit that plaything." Herta sighed, "If something's free, just take it!"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Herta's puppet appears in the Simulated Universe. Having only communicated with you via voice before, it's a little surprising to see her manifesting like this. She looks at you expressionlessly.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "Like," he stutters without looking at you, "like, uh, this is a random Occurrence now. I wrote some templates, but the Simulated Universe currently can't convert them into content. So, you will just see the following..."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Uh, yeah, that's how bland it'll be for now." The man says as if he is genuinely sorry.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Hopefully very soon," the man says earnestly. "I really want you to have a good time. Really. Um, once again, I'm really sorry about that."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: How's your experience with the official version? If you find it easy, you can go challenge the next world.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Apparently it's more difficult with stronger enemies. Screwllum said that, according to his model, you have a 60% chance of losing the first time, but it's not like you'll actually lose anything.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "That thing." Herta says impatiently. "You usually smash it with a bat when you walk past. Why didn't you go and hit it? Can't you see it?"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "You didn't see it..." You can hear Herta muttering angrily with gritted teeth. "You are so young, yet you have no idea how to be observant..."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "What a snob..." You can hear Herta muttering angrily with gritted teeth. "Isn't playing games all about smashing up everything you can see...?"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "This time it's different. This is the Simulated Universe." Herta sighs once again. "In the Simulated Universe, destructible objects can drop precious things called Cosmic Fragments. Now, go back and smash those things up."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "Mmm. Mmm." Herta replies flippantly. "As the game master, I can make your Blessings stronger, or even make earth-shattering changes to them — at the price of Cosmic Fragments. What's the point in collecting those otherwise? Now then, let's begin."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You'll clear it sooner or later.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Are you folks really here to research Aeons?
This is feeling more and more like a real game...
What are you talking about? Our goals haven't changed. Now run off and get ready.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "This is the resting area, giving you a place to catch your breath in an otherwise scary Simulated Universe. We hope you can restore your health, resurrect your team, buy equipment, and enhance your Blessings here." Herta says irresponsibly. "You can Enhance Blessings with me, and as for the other functions, you can find them in the room itself."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Enhance Blessings?
I need those other features too!

"Mmm. Mmm." Herta replies flippantly. "As the game master, I can make your Blessings stronger, or even make earth-shattering changes to them — at the price of paying Cosmic Fragments. What's the point in collecting those otherwise? Now then, let's begin."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Open the Enhance screen.
